1. Case overview

Summary. 8 plans were evaluated: 6 DMAT variants and 2 reference plans.

Clinical background and rationale. Sixteen brain targets planned to 20 Gy in one fraction using a single isocenter. The comparison examines target-level dose metrics, normal-brain exposure and delivery duration across energy groups.

Plan generation. DMAT plan generated for: Accela. DMAT-6FFF: 6FFF; 8 arcs; modulation +1, +3; DMAT-8FFF: 8FFF; 8 arcs; modulation +1, +3; DMAT-10FFF: 10FFF; 7 arcs, 8 arcs; modulation +1, +3 (DA244: 8 arcs; DA236: 7 arcs). Reference setup: Edge-HyperArc — 6FFF, 4 arcs; TB-HyperArc — 6FFF, 4 arcs.

Goal setup. The DMAT source reports contained 38 provided goals per plan, with priority identifiers, goal thresholds and acceptable-variation fields. Derived and automatic objectives were listed separately. For DA245, examples were GTV_Core V120.0 % ≥ 99.0 % (P2.16); AvoidBrdging D14.4 % < 19.90 Gy (P1.18).

Comparison methods. Dose colorwash, DVHs, individual endpoint–time plots and the saved 29-endpoint scorecard were compared. Comparative dose factors ranged from 0.9413 to 1.0850. Native optimizer audits retained their own dose basis. Scores summarize the selected endpoints. DMAT timing came from matched metrics; reference timing used an RT Plan control-point estimate.

2. Dose colorwash

Compare dose spread on the same slice across plans. Slice positions and the displayed dose scale are shared.

Scroll over a dose image to change slices. Use the slider or arrow keys as an alternative. Dragging is disabled.

Manual color anchors: 14.1→20 Gy. Anchor doses remain fixed when the display range changes.

Colorwash sampling details

Every dose is evaluated on DA236’s patient-coordinate dose grid before CT slices are sampled every 5 mm from its isocenter. Native grids that differ are trilinearly resampled. The in-plane display and superior–inferior slice range are restricted to the selected reference plan’s 40% prescription-dose bounding volume plus 50 mm in every direction; CT slices outside that range are not embedded. Each colorwash has a slim slice slider beneath it; moving any slider advances every plan synchronously. The compact zoom buttons, pointer drag, and reset remain synchronized and persist while changing slices. Mouse-wheel scrolling continues to move the report page. All plans use the confirmed 2–36.5 Gy color scale.

Per-plan SRS dose renormalization

  • DA246: SRS renormalization ×0.941328 (5.867% decrease) · limiting: Brain Metastasis 12 · minimum V100% 99.117% · all targets V100% ≥99%
  • DA243: SRS renormalization ×0.957155 (4.284% decrease) · limiting: Brain Metastasis 15 · minimum V100% 99.001% · all targets V100% ≥99%
  • DA237: SRS renormalization ×0.944502 (5.55% decrease) · limiting: Brain Metastasis 6 · minimum V100% 99.004% · all targets V100% ≥99%
  • DA244: SRS renormalization ×0.954177 (4.582% decrease) · limiting: Brain Metastasis 15 · minimum V100% 99.001% · all targets V100% ≥99%
  • DA236: SRS renormalization ×0.954849 (4.515% decrease) · limiting: Brain Metastasis 6 · minimum V100% 99.004% · all targets V100% ≥99%
  • Edge-HyperArc: SRS renormalization ×1.03584 (3.584% increase) · limiting: Brain Metastasis 8 · minimum V100% 99.009% · all targets V100% ≥99%
  • TB-HyperArc: SRS renormalization ×1.084953 (8.495% increase) · limiting: Brain Metastasis 16 · minimum V100% 99.006% · all targets V100% ≥99%

One shared multiplier per plan applies to all dose calculations and targets minimum coverage ≥99%. Dose reduction is optional; upward-only mode retains ×1 for sufficiently covered plans; finite samples and tied doses can prevent exactly 99%. Original D99 and coverage precede this multiplier.

Structures and dose share an interpolated grid (0.25 mm for normalization; otherwise adaptive 1–0.25 mm). Contours interpolate between planes without extra end slabs; dose uses trilinear interpolation. Exported DVHs are not used. CI uses the target plus a 3 mm Euclidean margin: Paddick = (TV∩PIV)²/(TV×PIV), RTOG = PIV/TV. GI = V50%/full PIV. V12 includes target tissue. Connected regions bridging at 50% or 12 Gy are combined separately, counting shared voxels once and retaining each target’s dose thresholds. Diameter uses target union volume. Any coarser GI/V12 sampling is listed in Resolution.

Scoring method

Imported or selected score curves, weights, and thresholds are retained. The traffic-light summary classifies evaluated values as goal, variation, or deviation; missing or unmapped endpoints contribute zero points. Native technical-report compliance scores remain separate.

Target V100%: coverage at the target prescription, goal ≥99%. Dmax: sampled point dose, binary 0/5 scoring. Mean GI counts each target/group once. Individual Paddick CI is excluded from scoring; CI plots retain the 3 mm search margin.

Planning notes

The recorded objective set included per-target Dmax objectives, GTV_Core V120%, Ring_outer at 5.5 Gy, and Brain-GTV V12/V6/V3 endpoints. The source planning notes additionally listed AvoidBrdging and target-specific priority adjustments.
